mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined month-over-month, or the Rank IC of the FEDFUNDS trend signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC of the FEDFUNDS threshold signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and FEDFUNDS (policy rate) indicates an inflation-driven monetary tightening cycle that reduces equity valuations through higher discount rates and lower real earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS have increased month-over-month, or the Rank IC of the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), tight labor market conditions generate wage pressures and inflation, triggering monetary policy responses that reduce equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC of the UNRATE signal in low unemployment regimes is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased month-over-month, or the Rank IC of the PAYEMS trend signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,400,000 units, it signals strong residential demand and associated economic activity that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 1400.0, or the Rank IC of the HOUST threshold signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0), manufacturing sector contraction reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC of the INDPRO signal in contraction regimes is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad-based weakness in consumer demand and manufacturing supply, signaling an economic slowdown that produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO have declined month-over-month, or the Rank IC of the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
